changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Aligned Controller admission with MiaAI-Lab's measured 0.94-utilization memory envelope.
changes.details: Raises the workload peak to 122.8 GB, covering the documented 114.3 GiB launch requirement, and uses the Controller's 4 GB system floor instead of double-counting host memory already absent from free inventory. The resulting 126.8 GB admission envelope preserves the runtime, image, model, and 384K profile unchanged.

changes.summary: Aligned the Mia single-Spark default with its physically tested 384K compact-NVFP4 origin profile.
changes.details: Packages the exact compact-KV, prefill, DSpark, and CUDA-graph overlays from the pinned Mia source and selects one request, 384K context, 0.94 utilization, CUDA graph sizes 6/12/24, and default thinking at max effort.

changes.summary: Added a conservative executable adaptation of MiaAI-Lab's one-Spark DeepSeek V4 Flash profile.
changes.details: Reuses the existing immutable SparkInfer target and offline adapter at the catalog's padded-KV 262K profile. The upstream compact-KV 384K overlay remains excluded until its additional kernel backports can be separately packaged and canaried.
